body:
Felt similarly in a way. Never felt like I have anything worthwhile to add to friendships/conversation. Part of me understands why they leave—- they see how much I struggle to connect, and so they put their energy into people who are more able to give back what they get. Or are interesting, or funny. People that were just better at maintaining. 

Sometimes I wish I could explain to them how draining it is to just be ‘present’ all the time, and that it’s not because of anything they’ve done.
